info.title: skolia lexicon
info.description: Dictionary entries for the languages skolia reads (English, French, Polish): senses, relations between words, pronunciations and inflected forms, mostly from Wiktionary. No sign-in. The content is CC BY-SA 4.0: each entry says whom to credit (attribution) and links its Wiktionary page (sourceUrl). A lexicon's version changes when a new build is loaded. Pass that version as a lookup query parameter to enable edge caching. An entry's id is {lang}:{lemma}:{upos}, a lemma with a / percent-encoded in a path (pl:i%2Flub:CCONJ).

incoming.description: With include=incoming, the relations pointing at this entry, 50 at most, by source id: each one's lemma and lemma_id are its source's, and the rest is as the source has it

incomingTruncated.description: With include=incoming, whether more than 50 point at it

CreditedEntry.description: A lexicon entry with its credits. Its paradigms' forms point into feature sets, ["psa", [50, 51]], which the response carries.

License.description: The licence the lexicon's content is under

via.description: Where skolia took it from, when that isn't the source

Attribution.description: A source to credit: its title, author, URL and licence

FeatureSets.description: The feature sets a response's paradigms use, by id: { "50": { Case: "Gen", ... } }. An id means something only within its language's loaded lexicon.

version.description: The version served, a hash of its entries, which changes whenever they do; null before one is loaded
